name: Проклятие! Великодушие
alt: Воин щедро раздаёт своё снаряжение, оставшись в смешном стёганом поддоспешнике.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, clear at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky forms, strong silhouette. Centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, frame or panels. Original composition, not copied card art. Clear plausible anatomy, no unintended extra limbs. Subject: One cheerful adult warrior in quilted cream gambeson and striped socks, exactly two arms and two legs, giving away his last steel helmet with both hands toward two empty open leather gift sacks. His sword and boots already sit inside the sacks. Proudly generous grin while his belt purse hangs inside-out empty, fully clothed, no nudity, no other people or hands.
